pages.zh:
特别科档案室。
案卷号 J. O. 55.

事由

关于上海预计发生叛乱运动的信函

涉及人员：
王德明（Wang Teh-ming）

pages.en:
February 23, 1916.

C. I. D.
I. O. REC
No. 55.
Date Feb 2/16.

My dear Phillips,

Enclosed is an apparently anonymous letter
which has been sent to me with a covering note. Copy of the
covering note I enclose for your information: the original
covering note and a copy of the "despatch" I am sending to the
Police for such investigation as may be possible.

Yours truly,

Acting Secretary.

Cop.
Is there such a person as
the writer of the letter known as
a white leader? It probably Barnato,
from the Pav temple.

24
2/16

There is such a person
His name has already
been mentioned in previous
reports. He is an engineer
from Japan, and is said to have
been an officer in the rebel army
at Wuchang in 1903 WM 25 2/16
pages.zh:
1916年2月23日。

刑事侦缉处
情报官收文
第55号。
日期 1916年2月2日。

亲爱的菲利普斯：

随函附上一封看似匿名的信件，该信是连同便条一起寄给我的。现附上便条副本供你参考：原始便条及该“急件”的副本我将送交警务处，以便进行可能的调查。

此致

代理秘书

抄件。
写信人是否确有其人，即那位被称为白人领袖的人？可能是巴纳托（Barnato），来自帕夫庙（Pav temple）。

24
1916年2月

确有此人
他的名字已在之前的
报告中提及。他是一名
来自日本的工程师，据说曾于1903年在武昌的叛军中担任军官 WM 25 1916年2月

Form 81
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
CAPTAIN SUPERINTENDENT'S OFFICE.
Translation of a letter from Wong Tseh Ming (王則民) (Address?).
No date. 191
Mackin (Mackinnon?) Esq.,
Capt. Supt. of Police.
Sir,
The letter, which I sent previously, is found
to have not been received. Apart from making
enquiries in the Post Office. I herewith forward
another letter for your information and hope you
will transmit same to the Consul of your nationality.
(Signed) Wong Tseh Ming.
(Stamped) Seal of the Commander's Headquarters
1st Division of Shanghai,
Anti-Yuan Army.

Rough translation of a letter addressed to British Consul-General.

I beg to state that Rebel Yuan(Shi-kai), who was
previously elected as the President of our nation, has done
malicious acts under the cover of Republicsm. He has failed
to keep his oath, stolen the peoples' power and abandoned
the Republic. He secretly calls himself Emperor, disregarded
thousands of brothers and refused to listen to the faithful
advice of neighbouring nations. Such a culprit is not only
hated by our 400 million people but is not countenanced by
European and American countries.

The "Ching Pu Tang " (進步黨 )Society declared for
revolt first and Tutuh Tang (唐 ) started a revolution
next. Kweichow and Kweiyang responded and Szechuen & Canton
are making progressive attacks. Nanking & Chekiang are also
making progress. Northern people(or soldiers) have an idea
to revolt, all Provincial Chiangchuns have similiar opinions,
although they have not clearly declared independence they
have the intention to protect the Republic. They(Provincial
Chiangchuns) have telegraphically conferred and decided to
stop and keep all funds which should have been forwarded to
the Central Government and to cease transfers of soldiers
in each Province, thus to stop Rebel Yuan's military funds
and strength for the fight. As soon as the Yangtsz River
communications are disconnected all soldiers from all
provinces will assemble together and make a joint fight with
a view to reaching the thief's haunt(Peking?) for the purpose
of sweeping away what has been left, then our brethern will
enjoy true happiness under the preserved Republic.

I, being the Commander dare not refuse but have to
collect all soldiers of this province, form them into
Divisions, appoint a date for uprising and assemble with
other Divisions to fight. This is my duty.

Fearing that bad characters, not knowing the movements
on this occasion, may misrepresent us for the purpose of

刑事侦缉处
情报官登记
编号....................................
致英国总领事信函的大意译文。

谨陈述，此前当选为我国总统的叛贼袁（世凯），在共和主义的掩护下行恶。他违背誓言，窃取人民权力，背弃共和。他暗中自称皇帝，无视万千同胞，并拒绝听从邻国的忠告。此等罪人不仅为我国四亿人民所痛恨，亦不为欧美各国所容。

“进步党”率先宣布起义，随后唐（Tutuh Tang）发动革命。贵州及贵阳响应，四川及广东正逐步进攻。南京及浙江亦有进展。北方民众（或士兵）已有起义之意，各省将军均持类似观点，虽未明确宣布独立，但有意保卫共和。他们（各省将军）已通过电报协商，决定截留本应上缴中央政府的所有款项，并停止各省间的军队调动，以此切断叛贼袁的军费及战力。一旦长江交通断绝，各省军队将集结一处，联合战斗，旨在直捣贼巢（北京？），以肃清余孽，届时我同胞将在得以保全的共和体制下享受真正的幸福。

本人身为司令，不敢推辞，唯有召集本省所有士兵，编为师团，定下起义日期，并与其他师团会合作战。此乃本人之职责。

恐有不肖之徒，因不知晓此次行动动向，为达到

committing fraud, extortion etc. I may say that it
will not cause the slightest disturbance, therefore
this letter is written to request you, the Consul-General
to take note and I beg you to notify the Shanghai residents
continue their peaceful business as usual and not to be
scared.
The above is the reason for forming this Division
and this is written for your information.
My name will be used in all further diplomatic
matters.

This is to the British Consul-General of Shanghai.

( Signed) Wong Tseh Ming.

Dated 20th day of 2nd moon of 5th year of Chinese Republic.

Seal of the Commander of 1st Division of Shanghai,
Anti-Yuan Army,
Chinese Republic.
pages.zh:
(2)

欺诈、勒索等目的而歪曲事实。本人可以说，此举不会引起丝毫骚乱，因此特致此函，恳请总领事阁下知悉，并乞请阁下通知上海居民继续照常和平经商，不必惊慌。
上述即为组建本师团之缘由，特此奉告。
今后所有外交事务均将使用本人姓名。

此致上海英国总领事。

（签名）王则民。

中华民国五年二月二十日。

中华民国上海讨袁军第一师司令印
